slides.text:
7 things everyone believes

(simply because everyone believes them)

1. “Busy means important.”

Busy usually means you never stopped long enough to ask what actually matters.

2. “A degree makes you smart.”

A degree proves you finished a program.

It doesn't measure your wisdom, your curiosity, or your courage.

3. “Retire at 65, then enjoy life.”

Why is the best part of the plan scheduled for when your body is the most tired?

4. “Being exhausted is normal.”

Common isn't the same as normal.

Constant exhaustion is a SIGNAL, not a personality.

5. “You have to be realistic.”

Usually means: shrink your dream so other people feel comfortable.

6. “Success means more.”

More money. More stuff. More followers.

But more of what you don't need still leaves you empty.

7. “That's just how it is.”

The most dangerous sentence there is.

Everything that “is” was once DECIDED by someone.

The herd follows beliefs.

The black sheep questions them.

Follow @jac_lavoiee for a different perspective.
